method: Bounded public-web search of Ukrainian, European Union, NATO, United States, United Kingdom, and Canadian official diplomacy, military-support, and sanctions surfaces, supplemented by exact-phrase screening of the known Reuters lead and repository-wide canonical identity review. No authentication, access-control bypass, secondary-to-primary timestamp substitution, inferred official URL, full-text capture, binary download, or operational geodata retention was used.

sources_checked.result: Reuters reported at 08:35 UTC that the Commission said a further EUR 1.4 billion from immobilised Russian-asset proceeds would support Ukraine.
